analyst_view.overall: Early view: Stuttgart under Sebastian Hoeneß have won three of their last five and are eighth, while Union Berlin under Mauro Lustrinelli are 16th after a 2-0 loss at Freiburg. Union have been the weakest away side in the league, with one point, one goal scored and 14 conceded on the road. One injury list has Angelo Stiller doubtful with a groin problem and Josha Vagnoman out for a few weeks.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean higher because Union have conceded heavily away from home all season, so Stuttgart could add to their expected 2.2. Union's poor away attack is the main thing that keeps this from going much higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. Union are likely to sit deep and defend their box, which tends to give the home side lots of corners. I lean a little higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. A relegation-threatened side defending deep often picks up bookings, which the model already reflects. The referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.5 shots. Stuttgart should do most of the shooting, while Union offer little in attack away from home, and those two roughly balance out. I stay with the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Whether Stiller plays matters for how cleanly Stuttgart build attacks, so this is a check for the final week. For now I stay with the site's figure.
